'''Adam Liu Dark Domination''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Adam Liu]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-3">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/3 Dark Domination], DeckTech (Adam "VCCGamerV" Liu, 11 August 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/3/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/3/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018233135/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/3/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Adam Liu]]
* '''Published:''' 11 August 1999 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Dark Domination''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)|Hoth-D-hothiceplains.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor HIP5M Liu DS 1999 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Just what the title says. It is a darkside walkers n' mains deck that has a lot of power to it.

== Original post ==

'''Dark Domination'''
* '''Author:''' Adam "VCCGamerV" Liu
* '''Published:''' August 11, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' Just what the title says. It is a darkside walkers n' mains deck that has a lot of power to it.

=== Strategy ===

This deck is just what its called, Dark Domination. This deck is a equal balance of ground beatdown and superior space. You start with either of the Rebel base locations, usually Hoth Ice Plains unless your opponent is playing a revolution deck. Start with any one of the effects according to your opponents deck. Try to get out sites as fast as possible and get down your effects, the effects are especially important, they are your "white blood cells". Deploy your starships and vehicles and start force draining. With all the effects and interrupts, you are not at any risk of beat down by any deck. You may want to change the deck around according to your local meta.
